description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages for three different methods—labeled in the legend as “Audio” (solid blue), “Noise” (solid purple), and “Random Choice” (dashed light blue)—across two model categories on the horizontal axis: “Audio-Reasoner” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni”. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For the “Audio-Reasoner” category, the “Audio” bar reaches approximately 37%, the “Noise” bar reaches approximately 30%, and the “Random Choice” bar is a dashed line at exactly 30%. For the “Qwen-2.5-Omni” category, the “Audio” bar reaches approximately 58%, and the “Noise” bar reaches approximately 36%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model category, with the “Audio” bars being taller than the “Noise” bars for both models. The chart does not show any sorting of bars by height, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
